title: Cooks well and quickly
text:
Cooks well and quickly. The rice cooker cooks well and quickly. It's also attractive.

The rice is perfect every time.

I would buy again.

product_metadata.title: Macook Rice Cooker 10 Cups (uncooked) 20 cups Rice Cooker (cooked) Large rice Cooker Suitable for Families of 3-5, Red
features: Easy Operation: Rice cooking can be incredibly simple with its one-touch operation panel. There are two settings of cook and keep warm. Just press the button and wait for 20 minutes, you will get delicious and fluffy rice. Even a novice can make perfect rice!

Multi-Cooker: Simple rice cookers also have many functions. In addition to basic rice cooking, you can also cook a wide range of recipes, including porridge, stew, steaming vegetables, and even baking cakes.

Best Budget Rice Cooker: Why labor over a stovetop, wasting time, attention, and burner space on preparing rice in a pot when a small kitchen appliance will do the job for you perfectly? For household cooking, this cost-effective rice cooker is all you need! It's cute, futuristic as well as fashionable. Just enjoy your real, neat, and warm cooking experience in your cozy kitchen.

Best Large Capacity Rice Cooker: Our Macook cooker has a max. 10-cup raw capacity (4.2 quarts) and can produce 10 to 20 cups of fluffy cooked rice. This is suitable for families of 3-5. Whether preparing food for a summer party or for dinner on the kitchen table, the detachable power cord and comfortable handle design make it easy to take your electric cooker anywhere.
Non-Toxic Rice Cooker: Macook rice cooker is 100% non-toxic, lead-free and cadmium-free, and safe to cook.

details.Included Components: 1x Rice measuring cup, 1x Detachable power cord, 1x Rice spoon, 1x Rice pot, 1x Steamer, 1x Tempered glass lid, User manual
